sbh3.2:3.1: sā khalveṣā vipaśyanā trimukhī ṣaḍvastuprabhedālambanā veditavyā |
sbh3.2:3.16: yadā punastīrayitvā upaparīkṣya yathā vyavasthāpitameva pratyavekṣate |
sbh3.2:4.4: arthaṁ, vastu, lakṣaṇaṁ, pakṣaṁ, kālaṁ, yuktiṁ ca paryeṣyannetānyeva paryeṣamāṇa etānyeva pratyavekṣate |
sbh3.2:5.32: ayaṁ dharmaḥ, idaṁ kāritraṁ, ayamidaṁ kāritra iti |
sbh3.2:5.36: atrātmā, nāstīti kiṁ pratyakṣamupalabhyate na veti, kimanumānena prayujyate na veti |
sbh3.2:5.37: tatra dharmatāyuktyā tathābhūtatāṁ dharmāṇāṁ prasiddhadharmatāmacintyadharmatāmavasthitadharmatāmadhimucyate, na cintayati |
sbh3.2:7.3: aśubhādhipateyaṁ dharmaṁ śrutamudgṛhītamadhipatiṁ kṛtvā samāhitabhūmikena manaskāreṇaivamarthapratisaṁvedī bhavati |
sbh3.2:8.2: sa evamarthapratisaṁvedī tāmaśubhatāṁ dvayorbhāvayorvyavasthāpitāṁ paśyatyadhyātmaṁ bahirdhā ca |
sbh3.2:9.3: santyasminkāye keśā romāṇi nakhā dantā rajo malaṁ tvaṅmāṁsamasthi snāyuḥ sirā vṛkkaṁ hṛdayaṁ plīhakaṁ kloma antrāṇyantraguṇā āmāśayaṁ pakvāśayaṁ mūtraṁ purīṣamaśru svedaḥ kheṭā śiṅghāṇakaṁ vasā lasīkā majjā medaḥ pittaṁ śleṣmā pūyaḥ śoṇitamastakaṁ mastakaluṅgaṁ prasrāvaḥ |
sbh3.2:10.3: yadanena mṛtakuṇapaṁ svayaṁ vā dṛṣṭaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:10.4: purato vā śrutaṁ parikalpitaṁ vā, punaḥ striyā vā, puruṣasya vā, mitrasya vā, amitrasya vā, udāsīnasya vā |
sbh3.2:10.5: hīnaṁ vā, madhyaṁ vā, praṇītaṁ vā, dahrasya vā, madhyasya vā, vṛddhasya vā |
sbh3.2:10.6: tatra nimittamudgṛhya ekāham mṛtaṁ pragaḍitaśoṇitamayaṁ prāptapūyabhāvaṁ vinīlakamityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:10.8: saptāham mṛtaṁ sañjātakṛmi ādhmātaṁ ca vyādhmātakamityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:10.9: kākaiḥ kuralairgṛddhaiḥ śvabhiḥ śṛgālair khādyamānaṁ vikhāditakamityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:10.11: diśodiśamaṅgapratyaṅgeṣu vikṣipteṣu viśleṣiteṣu samāṁseṣu nirmāṁseṣu kiñcicchiṣṭamāṁseṣu vikṣiptakamityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:11.1: api ca dve śaṅkalike dehaśaṅkalikā pratyaṅgaśaṅkalikā ca |
sbh3.2:11.2: tatra dehaśaṅkalikā śroṇīkaṭāhamupādāya pṛṣṭhīvaṁśo yāvadyatra śiraskapālaṁ pratiṣṭhitam |
sbh3.2:11.6: api ca dvau śaṅkalikāyā nimittagrāhau citrakṛtāyāḥ pāṣāṇakāṣṭhaśādakṛtāyā vā |
sbh3.2:12.1: sa khalveṣa bāhyāyā varṇanibhāyā upādāyarūpagatāyāstrividho vipariṇāmaḥ |
sbh3.2:12.5: tatra vikhāditakamupādāya yāvad vikṣiptakāt parakṛto vipariṇāmaḥ |
sbh3.2:12.6: tatrāsthikā vā śaṅkalikā vā ityayamubhayapakṣyo vipariṇāmaḥ |
sbh3.2:12.7: ya evaṁ yathābhūtaṁ prajānāti bahirdhā aśubhatāmākārata evaṁ bahirdhā aśubhatāyāḥ svalakṣaṇaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:13.2: yathā cādhyātmaṁ bahiḥ kāyasyāśubhā varṇanibhayā apariṇatā yāvad bahirdhā bahiḥ kāyasyāśubhā varṇanibhā vipariṇatā ādhyātmikayā aśubhayā varṇanibhā samānadharmatāṁ tulyadharmatāmadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:13.3: iyamapi me śubhā varṇanibhā evaṁ dharmiṇī iti |
sbh3.2:13.4: ye 'pi kecit sattvā anayā śubhayā varṇanibhayā samanvāgatāsteṣāmapi sāśubhāyāṁ evaṁ dharmiṇī tadyatheyaṁ bāhyā |
sbh3.2:14.4: tāṁ yathābhūtamaprajānann adhyātmaṁ vā bahirdhā vā śubhāyāṁ varṇanibhāyāṁ saṁrāgamutpādayāmi viparyāsa eva kṛṣṇapakṣasaṅgṛhītaḥ |
sbh3.2:14.7: yā punarasyāṁ śubhāyāṁ varṇanibhāyāṁ aśubhadharmatānugatā yathābhūtānupaśyanā śuklapakṣyā |
sbh3.2:14.8: eṣa dharmaḥ aduḥkhaḥ avighātaḥ yāvad atonidānā upāyāsā nirudhyante |
sbh3.2:14.9: tatra yo 'yaṁ kṛṣṇapakṣasamayo nādhivāsayitavyaḥ prahātavyo viśodhayitavyaḥ |
sbh3.2:15.3: yeyamadhyātmaṁ aśubhā varṇanibhā seyaṁ vartamānamadhvānamupādāya yā punariyaṁ bahirdhā aśubhā varṇanibhā iyamapi vartamāna tāmevādhvānamupādāya |
sbh3.2:15.6: saiṣā tāvadatītamadhvānamupādāya śubhā satī tadyathā me etarhi |
sbh3.2:15.8: evamānupūrvyā etarhi vartamānamupādāya aśubhā saṁvṛttā, sā me iyaṁ aśubhā varṇanibhā vartamānamadhvānamupādāya aśubhā satī |
sbh3.2:15.12: iti hyatītānāgatapratyutpanneṣvadhvasvayamapi me kāya evaṁbhāvī, evaṁbhūtaḥ, etāṁ ca dharmatāmanatīta ityevaṁ kālaṁ samanveṣate |
sbh3.2:16.3: nāstīti sa kaścidātmā vā sattvo vā adhyātmaṁ vā bahirdhā vopalabhyamānaḥ yaḥ śubho vā syādaśubho vā |
sbh3.2:16.4: api ca rūpamātrametat kaṇḍavaramātrametad yatreyaṁ saṁjñā samājñā prajñaptirvyavahāraḥ |
sbh3.2:16.9: tasyāsya mṛtasya kālagatasyānupūrveṇa vipariṇatā imā avasthāḥ prajñāyante |
sbh3.2:16.10: yaduta vinīlakamiti vā yāvadasthiśaṅkalikāyā vā ayamapi me kāyaḥ |
sbh3.2:16.13: yena hetunā, yena nidānena iyaṁ tāvatkālikī śubhā varṇanibhā prajñāyate |
sbh3.2:16.14: antaḥkāyaḥ punarnityaṁ nityakālamadhyātmaṁ ca bahirdhā cāśubhā evaṁ saṁvṛtiparamārthanidānataḥ |
sbh3.2:17.1: tasyaivaṁ bhavatīyamaśubhatā evamāsevitā bhāvitā bahulīkṛtā kāmarāgaprahāṇāya saṁvartate |
sbh3.2:17.5: aśubhā āsevitā bhāvitā bahulīkṛtā kāmarāgaprahāṇāya saṁvartata ityayaṁ tāvanme āptāgamaḥ |
sbh3.2:17.7: ahamasmi yathā yathā aśubhatāṁ bhāvayāmi, manasi karomi |
sbh3.2:18.2: maitryadhipateyaṁ dharmamadhipatiṁ kṛtvā hitasukhādhyāśayagatasya sarveṣu sukhopasaṁhārādhimokṣalakṣaṇā maitrītyetamarthapratisaṁvedyarthaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:19.2: sarva ete pakṣāḥ parasantānapatitatvād bāhyaṁ vastvityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:19.3: mitrapakṣaṁ vā adhyātmamamitrodāsīnapakṣaṁ bahirdhā evaṁ ca vastuni maitrīṁ samanveṣate |
sbh3.2:20.2: ya ete trayaḥ pakṣāḥ aduḥkhā sukhatāḥ |
sbh3.2:20.7: ye punarete aduḥkhāsukhitāḥ pakṣāḥ sukhakāmāsteṣāṁ trividhā sukhakāmatā prajñāyate |
sbh3.2:20.11: evaṁ saprītikena niṣprītikena ca sukhena veditavyam |
sbh3.2:21.16: nātra kaścidyaḥ ākrośate vā, ākruśyate vā |
sbh3.2:21.21: śabdamātraṁ māṣamātrametadapi ca tathā saṁbhūto 'yaṁ kāyo rūpī audārikaścāturmahābhautiko yatra me sthitasyeme evaṁ rūpāḥ sparśāḥ krāmanti |
sbh3.2:21.24: anitya, ete 'pi sparśā ye te apakārakāste 'pyanityāḥ |
sbh3.2:21.26: sarva eva sattvā jātijarāvyādhimaraṇadharmāṇaste prakṛtyaiva duḥkhitāstanme pratirūpaṁ syāt |
sbh3.2:21.27: yadyahaṁ prakṛtiduḥkhiteṣu sattveṣu bhūyo duḥkhopasaṁhārameva kuryāṁ, na sukhopasaṁhāraṁ tadamitratraṁ mitrasya kuryādyad ete sattvā ātmanaivātmanaḥ kurvanti |
sbh3.2:22.3: yo 'nena dīrghasyādhvanotyayān mātā vā bhūt pitā vā, bhrātā vā, bhaginī vā, ācāryo vā, upādhyāyo vā, gururvā, gurusthānīyo veti |
sbh3.2:22.5: na cātra kasyacit pariniṣpattiḥ, mitrāmitrabhāvo, mitro 'pi tramapi ca kālāntareṇāmitro traṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:23.2: yo me pāpakāriṣu sattveṣu vyāpādaḥ maraṇa eṣa dharma iti vistareṇa pūrvavat |
sbh3.2:23.3: yo vā punarayametarhyavyāpādaḥ amaraṇa eṣa dharma iti vistareṇa pūrvavat |
sbh3.2:24.2: ye tāvadatītamadhvānamupādāya sukhakāmāḥ sattvāḥ te atītāḥ, teṣāṁ kiṁ punaḥ sukhopasaṁhāraṁ kariṣyāmaḥ |
sbh3.2:24.4: yāvadanāgatādadhvano nityakālaṁ sukhino bhavantvityevaṁ maitryāḥ kālaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:25.2: nāsti kaścidātmā vā, sattvo vā ya eṣa sukhakāmo vā syāt |
sbh3.2:25.4: api tu skandhamātrametat saṁskāramātrakametad yatraiṣā saṁjñā saṁjñaptirvyavahāraḥ |
sbh3.2:25.5: te punaḥ saṁskārāḥ karmakleśahetukā ityevamapekṣāyuktyā maitrīm paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:25.6: prasiddhadharmatā khalveṣā acintyadharmatā yan maitrīvyāpādabhāvanā prahāṇāya saṁvartata ityevaṁ dharmatāyuktyā maitrīm paryeṣate |
